### 目标

### Section 结构（来自 writing_plan.yaml）
- §3.1 Problem Setup: given code patch p and test suite T={t1,...,tn}, goal is per-test binary verdict → aggregate to patch-level correctness
- §3.2 Per-Test Binary Classification (CLS): f(code_context, test_input) → {PASS, FAIL}; single-token output; cross-entropy loss; inference = 1 token per test
- §3.3 Execution Output Generation (CWM): g(code_context, test_input) → output_string; variable-length generation; exact-match against expected output → derive PASS/FAIL; inference = N tokens per test (N = output length)
- §3.4 Trajectory-Level Scoring (TRAJ): h(code_context, full_test_suite) → {RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED}; single binary per patch; no per-test signal; controls for granularity difference
- §3.5 CWM Failure Mode Analysis: (a) token-budget exhaustion when output_length exceeds generation budget; (b) string-value prediction errors on complex return types — both absent in CLS by construction
- §3.6 Oracle Accuracy-Utility Framework: formalize per-test advantage as function of (accuracy, F2P_test_count T, P2P_regression_rate, error_correlation ICC); block-correlation model capturing non-i.i.d. prediction errors; derive threshold conditions

- p: candidate patch

- f: per-test classifier (CLS)
- g: output generator (CWM)
- h: trajectory-level scorer (TRAJ)
- rho (ρ): intra-cluster correlation (ICC)

函数级 CLS ≈ CWM（等价，TOST p=0.007），但 classification 随 complexity 增长优势扩大（4B: 1.25pp → 8B: 2.43pp → repo-level: TBD）。这是因为 CWM 有两个 failure modes（token-budget exhaustion + string-value prediction errors），在简单代码上不触发，在复杂代码上才显现。Classification 天然回避了这两个 failure modes。
